notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Content Changes[/h2]
[h3]Game language can now be changed to Japanese[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can choose to change your language in the options menu.
[*] When you open the game for the first time since this update, you will be asked to choose your language.
[/list]
[h3]Skipping levels will now count as "reaching" them for level select purposes.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now when you skip a level you will be able to resume from the level after it.
[/list]
[h3]New Menu Option[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can choose to let the game run in the background now (if the game is focused/unfocused).
[/list]
[h3]Music Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Music ramps up at a different pace between levels now.
[*] Will rise faster but occasionally fall as the player makes progress instead of just rising slowly.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if you leaped towards an outer wall under certain conditions, you would teleport outside of the game area.
[*] Fixed issues in a few levels where pits had no colliders.
[*] Fixed a spelling error in Ineptus's first dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where One Shot, One Kill's exit teleporter sometimes did not work.
[/list]

notes.title: Soundtrack Released!
notes.content:
Time Turned's Soundtrack created by Zachary Kaye at Svidanza Audio has been released for separate purchase. It contains all the music from Time Turned plus some additional tracks for your listening pleasure. Feel like a secret agent as you listen to the 90s spy inspired soundtrack. Go give it a listen!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3272090/Time_Turned_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Content Changes[/b][/h2]
[h3]Save Slots and Slot Menu has changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]No longer displayed the level no. the save has reached in the preview.
[*]Now displays the name of the level when the slot has been selected.
[/list]
[h3]Save files are now stored alongside the game data instead of their previous location[/h3]
[list]
[*]All existing save files should be migrated safely on launch of the new version.
[/list]
[h3]Cloud Saves are now integrated[/h3]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Remapping controls on a controller did not change how the on screen keyboard was navigated when prompted for a name. They should now be remapped correctly.
[*]Main Menu sometimes showed the save slot selection menu and the play menu overlapping. This no longer happens.
[*]Achivements sometimes did not unlock when they should. They now should. Be aware that some achivements only appear once the game closes.
[/list]

notes.title: Time Turned bug fixes for macOS
notes.content:
An issue was being encountered that disallowed users to play the game on macOS devices with this error: "Your current macOS version is unable to run 32-bit games."

This issue has been remedied and now macOS devices should be supported and working normally.

notes.title: Time Turned has Released
notes.content:
After 2 years of development, Time Turned has finally hit the shelves.

Send your puzzlers, your 10000 IQ genuises,
They are yearning to be stumped,
To be pushed to their very limits of puzzle decoding,
And to command the cadence of time.

Play Time Turned today and get the demo free.
